dialogues.text: The north stair is passable again. I counted seventeen broken tiles and left a chalk mark at the fifth landing.
Meet me by the east well at half past four, not the old fountain; the mason moved his cart there this morning.
Three barley loaves cost six septims today. I can hold one until dusk, but I cannot promise the price tomorrow.
I found a brass key beneath the blue bench, beside a note signed by Captain Rhel. I have not opened the cellar.
Good morning. The rain finally stopped, and the baker has set two warm trays near the south window.
I will not enter that locked room for you. Ask the owner first, and leave the crowbar outside.
Cross the market, turn left at the bronze stag, then follow the canal for about two hundred paces. The archive door is green.
I can travel as far as Greywatch before sunset. We should buy lamp oil there and avoid the flooded track beyond mile marker nine.
You have been standing in the cold for a while. Would you like to sit inside while I bring your parcel from the stable?
The shield needs four iron rivets and a new leather strap. Bring the materials before noon and I can finish it by tomorrow.
Mara at the ferry says a lantern moved across the marsh last night. I did not see it myself, so treat that as her account.
You asked for two hours of loading, and I agreed to the posted rate of twelve coins. I will pay when the last crate is checked.
The blue wool is sound, but the hem is loose. I can offer nine coins as it is, or mend it for you by Friday.
I waited beside the south gate until the bell rang twice. If you still want to meet, send word before I leave for the quarry.
I still set a cup for my sister each winter. It is a small habit, but the quiet feels heavier when I stop.
That satchel is yours; I found it under the bench with your initials inside. Nothing was missing when I handed it to the guard.
Take the third stair, pass room twenty-one, and knock once at the narrow oak door. The clerk closes the ledger at six.
The bridge boards shifted under my cart. Keep to the stone edge, leave the mule behind, and tell the watch before anyone crosses.
I have no red dye left. The ledger says the next shipment arrives on the ninth, but the road is still muddy.
The council wants the sealed letter delivered unopened. You may refuse the errand, though the magistrate will choose another courier.
I spent my last copper on oats this morning. If the kitchen has spare broth, I can trade an hour of sweeping for a bowl.
I took the wrong lantern from your shelf. Here it is, cleaned and repaired; please check the brass hook before you say it is settled.
You mentioned your brother was due on the noon coach. Did he arrive safely, or should I ask the station keeper to check the passenger list?
The southern beacon is lit, but the ship has not returned.

emotionConditions.direction: Read plainly, with no added emotional color.
Read with audible joy, while keeping the words unchanged.
Read with audible anger, without shouting unless the backend naturally requires it.
Read with audible concern and attention to the uncertain outcome.
Read with audible grief, without changing or adding words.
Read with audible fear, without changing or adding words.

deliveryModes.direction: Use the profile's normal speaking volume.
Whisper audibly with confidential, nervous, or conspiratorial intent as specified separately; do not substitute a hushed normal voice if it is not recognizably a whisper.

exactTextEmotionPairs.invariant: For a given profile, backend/model revision, and voice-reference hash, all six render requests use the exact dialogue text from the single referenced dialogue row. Only the emotion condition changes.

exactTextDeliveryPairs.invariant: For each same-NPC pair, preserve the exact dialogue text, emotion, identity descriptor, backend/model revision, and voice-reference hash. Change deliveryMode only; vary whisperIntent across separate whisper trials. Score intelligibility and identity consistency as well as whether it sounds like a whisper.

lineIdMapping: lineId in a render record maps to the id of the referenced dialogues[] row; render text must be copied exactly from that row.
renderIdentityRule: Use a deterministic unique utteranceId for each planned render stage/profile/line/emotion/deliveryMode/whisperIntent tuple. A retry of the exact same tuple reuses that ID; backend-reload and game-save-load repeats get distinct stage IDs. Bind each requestId to the exact utterance and reject late responses whose conversationLifetimeToken is stale.

nativeTransferStatus.status: profile/emotion/delivery metadata is not currently transferred to the synthesizer; the corpus does not claim that it is.

disclosureBoundary: Whisper is only a delivery mode. It does not authorize access to confidential, private, quest-protected, or otherwise undisclosed information. Use only dialogue that native game state permits this NPC to say.

repeatPlan.invariant: Repeat both exact dialogue lines with the same stable profile ID, descriptor, voice reference/configuration and backend/model revision. Record any unavoidable revision change explicitly instead of treating it as an exact identity repeat.
repeatPlan.changedLineComparison: Compare each profile's anchorDialogueId with its distinct coverageDialogueId within each stage; do not confuse text-driven performance variation with identity drift.
